Why Faculty Choose Digital Ordering

Skip the canteen queue and save valuable time

🚫 No More Long Queues

During lunch breaks, the canteen gets crowded with students. Faculty members often spend 15-20 minutes waiting in line, cutting into their limited break time.

Solution: Order online from your office or classroom. Your food is prepared while you finish your work. Just walk in and collect - no waiting!

⏰ Order Between Classes

Tight schedule between lectures? Place your order 10 minutes before your break. By the time you reach the canteen, your meal is ready for pickup.

Time Saved: Faculty members save an average of 15 minutes per order - that's more time for preparation or a proper lunch break!

⚡

Quick & Easy

Order in 30 seconds from anywhere on campus. No app download needed - works on any device.

💳

Flexible Payment

Pay via UPI, card, or cash on collection. Choose what's convenient for you.

📊

Track Orders

View your order history and reorder your favorites with one click.

{/* How It Works */}

How It Works

Simple steps for faculty members

1. Browse Menu

View all available items with prices and descriptions.

2. Place Order

Select items, choose payment method, and confirm order.

3. Collect

Pick up your order from the canteen counter at your convenience.
